faq.q: What makes a good scarab beetle name?
faq.a: A good scarab beetle name should match your pet's personality, be easy to pronounce and remember, and ideally be one or two syllables. The best names reflect something unique about the animal while being practical for everyday use.

faq.q: Should I choose a name based on my scarab beetle's appearance?
faq.a: Absolutely! scarab beetle's distinctive features make wonderful naming inspiration. Names based on color, size, or markings create an immediate connection and help others appreciate your pet's unique beauty.

faq.q: Can I use a human name for my scarab beetle?
faq.a: Human names are very popular for pets! Names like Charlie, Max, Luna, and Bella work wonderfully and can make your bond with your scarab beetle feel even more personal and meaningful.

faq.q: How many names should I consider before choosing?
faq.a: We recommend shortlisting 3-5 favorite names, then testing them over a few days. Say each name aloud during different activities — the one that consistently feels natural is your winner.

faq.q: Do scarab beetles respond better to certain sounds?
faq.a: Animals tend to respond best to names ending in a vowel sound, especially 'ee' sounds like Charlie or Lucy. Names with hard consonants at the beginning (like K, T, B) also capture attention more effectively.
